summary: Delivery centres as 2-4 flat cards, each topped by three photos of the place stacked like a small fan (after Cosmos on Mobbin): the main photo in front, two smaller ones peeking out behind it. On first view the back photos slide out from behind the front one; on hover or focus the front photo grows and the back ones tuck in. Under the photos: flag, city and country, a headcount or services line and an optional note. Needs three real photos per centre (the office, the street or city, a desk or room); for one photo per hub use country-cards.
